The semantic raw check-in file is identifiable as loc-gowalla_totalCheckins.txt.gz, but no immutable provider release, checksum, exact consumed bytes, or custody receipt is public in the inspected sources.

The NGCF and pinned LightGCN repositories carry byte-identical Git objects for README.md, user_list.txt, item_list.txt, train.txt, and test.txt; this closes only the processed NGCF-to-LightGCN transfer edge.

The original papers publish aggregate counts and high-level filter/split rules, but not the raw parser, intermediary selection, deduplication, core algorithm, ID-map order, preprocessing code/argv/config, split PRNG/seed/rounding, validation membership, or end-to-end hashes.
